notes:
Lead source: inbound from blog post "How to build a fast RAG doc search with embeddings".

Customer context: small SaaS (B2B KB product) — primary product is in-app knowledge search for SMB customers. Inbound trial — wants hosted API, low integration friction.

Use-case details (from call):
- Index size: currently 12k docs (mix of PDF, markdown). Expect steady growth to ~120k within 12 months.
- Query pattern: ~150 QPS peak across tenants, but per-tenant QPS low. Need per-tenant isolation for relevance.
- Latency targets: top-k search end-to-end <200ms p50 for embeddings + rerank (they said "under 200ms feels good").
- Throughput: batch embedding of new docs nightly (5k docs/night); online reranking on read requests.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB margins; wants hosted pricing estimate and examples for 50-200k doc deployments.

Technical questions asked repeatedly:

Security & trial constraints:
- Must support SSO/SAML for internal admin portal (trial org admin flow).
- SOC2 attestation required before procurement.
- Audit logs important for enterprise customers; want retention controls on logs/queries.

POC asks / success criteria:
- Demo end-to-end: ingest 12k docs from their S3, generate embeddings, index to vector store (or Redwood-managed index), run search + rerank.
- Accuracy: top-3 results must have explicit source attribution and relevance >80% on our prompt tests.
- Performance: p50 latency <=200ms on hosted setup for 50 qps sim.

Quote from product lead: "We need something plug-and-play for our SMB customers — if the hosted workflow is fast and cheap, we'll prefer it over maintaining Pinecone clusters."
